statement_record.book: Generalizing Proposition 3.4.8: for any F : C ⟶ Set, the projection Pi from the category of elements of F to C (i) strictly creates all limits that C admits and that F preserves, and (ii) strictly creates all connected colimits that C admits.
statement_record.intree: Definition comma_limit : Limit K (with apex ((ttt, vertex_obj[Ldiag]); phi), Ldiag the chosen C-limit of comma_proj2 ◯ K) under (HC : @Complete C) and (HU : PreservesImageLimit U); Definition Comma_Complete (HU : PreservesImageLimit) (HC : @Complete C) : @Complete (=(d) ↓ U).

gap: There is no definition of an absolute (co)limit.
